description: This file is the code-behind for an ASP.NET Web Forms page that displays exam results. It interacts with session variables, updates user information in a SQL database, and handles navigation button clicks.

classes.name: ExamResult
classes.description: Partial class for the ExamResult page, handling page load and button click events for displaying exam results and navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; retrieves session variables, updates the user info in the database, and displays result data.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the user profile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the leaderboard page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles user logout and redirects to login page.
